STOR.description: Story (STOR). One entry per story keyed by story id; defines the story name/elevation, floor-diaphragm flag, and the wind and seismic eccentricity parameters used in lateral load distribution, plus an optional list of story-area factor points.

bFLOOR_DIAPHRAGM.description: Whether the floor at this story level acts as a rigid floor diaphragm in lateral load distribution.

WIND_FLOOR_WIDTH_X.description: Effective floor width in the X-direction subjected to wind load.

WIND_FLOOR_WIDTH_Y.description: Effective floor width in the Y-direction subjected to wind load.

WIND_CENTER_X.description: GCS X-coordinate of the wind floor center to which the wind load is applied.

WIND_CENTER_Y.description: GCS Y-coordinate of the wind floor center to which the wind load is applied.

WIND_ECCENT_X.description: Wind eccentricity distance in the X-direction at this story.

WIND_ECCENT_Y.description: Wind eccentricity distance in the Y-direction at this story.

SEIS_ACC_ECCENT_X.description: Seismic accidental eccentricity distance in the X-direction at this story.

SEIS_ACC_ECCENT_Y.description: Seismic accidental eccentricity distance in the Y-direction at this story.

SEIS_INHERENT_ECCENT_X.description: Seismic inherent eccentricity distance in the X-direction at this story.

SEIS_INHERENT_ECCENT_Y.description: Seismic inherent eccentricity distance in the Y-direction at this story.

SEIS_TORSIONAL_AMP_FACTOR_X.description: Seismic torsional amplification factor in the X-direction.

SEIS_TORSIONAL_AMP_FACTOR_Y.description: Seismic torsional amplification factor in the Y-direction.

STORY_AREA_ITEMS.description: Optional list of story-area factor points. Applied only when the list is non-empty; each item carries X/Y/Z factors for the story area.

X.description: X factor of the story-area point.

Y.description: Y factor of the story-area point.

Z.description: Z factor of the story-area point.
